notes.title: Linea VR is out!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33019266/b0a460c4219a031927f60af768bf9fc5d4763115.png

Hi friends!

KHB-Soft's main dev Oxy949 here with great news!

Remastered VR-version of "Linea, the Game" is finally available for playing. As I said before it was really fun to remake my old game for VR! And thanks you all for your feedback during beta-test.

Have fun and see you soon!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1144100/Linea_VR

notes.title: Update 1.1.1
notes.content: Temporarily removed mobs amputation due to critical bugs

notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32545659/8c590ef46702b9bc5eade3e62a079de1b9d3bdd8.jpg

Hi everyone! Oxy949 here with some good news. Our team prepared new big update for you! 

• Added new archive №38. Discover new side-story while holding against endless waves of enemies. Hint: the archive files can be found in caves.
• Added mobs dismember with more blood
• Added sounds for mobs
• Added ammo for guns
• Removed falling items damage
• Reordered main menu elements
• Fixed lots of bugs

notes.title: Update 1.0.3
notes.content:

notes.title: Update 1.0.2
notes.content:
Today we have fixed even more bugs:

• Lots of localization mistakes
• Fixed bugs with lighting
• Fixed main menu resolutions list bug
• Improved Archive 142 security


As always, If you find a bug please let us know in a special section of the Steam community 
or on the discord server

Have fun!

notes.title: Game Price Has Changed
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32545659/bcc8d61cd245cd351ab28f9e4d321d74b9a6735d.png
Dear friends!

Due to your requests, we decided to reduce the price of "Changeover: Decisions" to 1.99$.
This price will remain until release of the second chapter and  then will be increased. We remind you this game is one-purchase and includes all the story chapters.

Удачи!

notes.title: Update 1.0.1
notes.content:
Ladies and gentlemen, we have fixed some bugs:

• Improved inventory. Now there is a tooltip when you hover over the object
• Fixed time lines on some endings (cases when the game crashes)
• Fixed global variables to be considered in the second chapter
• Added warning message, when you start a new game without training
• Fixed some spelling mistakes

If you find bugs, please let us know in a special section of the Steam community 
or on the discord server

Enjoy the game!
